description: The plot titled “Performance w.r.t. Temperature” illustrates Pass@8 accuracy on the merged AIME 2024 and AMC sets as a function of generation temperature for three methods (On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT). The x-axis is labeled “Temperature,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0.1 to 1.0 with ticks at every 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Pass@8),” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 62.5 to 80.0+ with regularly spaced tick marks at 2.5-point intervals (e.g., 62.5, 65.0, 67.5, …, 80.0). The On-policy RL series is drawn as an orange solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it starts near 63.5 at temperature 0.1, rises to about 70.0 at 0.2, stays around 69.0–72.0 through 0.6, drops to about 67.5 at 0.7, peaks around 75.0 at 0.8, and ends near 73.5 at 1.0 (with an intermediate point near 71.0 at 0.9). The LUFFY series is a red solid line with star markers; it begins around 76.0 at 0.1, reaches about 78.8 at 0.2, sits near 76.2–77.0 from 0.3 to 0.6, increases to about 79.7 at 0.7 and about 80.5 at 0.8, dips to about 78.8 at 0.9, and returns to about 80.5 at 1.0. The SFT series is a teal solid line with downward-pointing triangle markers; it starts around 76.2 at 0.1, declines to about 75.0 at 0.2 and about 74.3 at 0.3–0.4, drops to about 70.0 at 0.5, rises back to about 76.0 at 0.6, then moves between roughly 71.8 and 73.5 from 0.7 to 0.9, ending near 74.3 at 1.0.
